base_member_text: [L79-L85] (MED/portability) The Fortran preprocessor fallback is hard-coded to /lib/cpp -C -ansi without checking that the executable exists or selecting a configured system preprocessor, so configurations lacking that exact path can fail or use an unsuitable preprocessor.
audit_member_text: [L81-L84] (MED/tool-discovery) The Fortran preprocessor defaults to the hardcoded /lib/cpp path and C-oriented options without checking availability or Fortran compatibility.
[L24-L29,L38-L45,L90-L110,L116-L138,L144-L167] (LOW/language-contract) Several Fortran probes neither select the Fortran language nor document their dependence on the caller's current language.
